verdict.rationale: First-party tracing docs explicitly cover both languages: `@weave.op()` in Python and wrapping with `weave.op()` in TypeScript automatically capture code, inputs, outputs, and metadata. The GitHub repo and OTel-compatible SDK docs reinforce official instrumentation support. Missing for 10: JS/TS SDK installation and package details, evidence of feature parity between the Python and TS SDKs (e.g., integrations and auto-patching in TS), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the TS SDK.
